# Semgrep rules that block whatever their severity (decision of 19 Nov 2026: ERROR findings block, plus
# these WARNING rules, which guard against real attacks). A caller's semgrep_exclude_rules still turns a
# rule off entirely: the default list excludes the mutable-action-tag rule, as before.
# Hidden bidirectional characters (Trojan Source).
generic.unicode.security.bidi.contains-bidirectional-characters
solidity.security.no-bidi-characters.no-bidi-characters
# An action referenced by a tag or branch, which its owner can move.
yaml.github-actions.security.github-actions-mutable-action-tag.github-actions-mutable-action-tag
